comment:
* A layout drawing views under system bars, called {@link Protection}s, to ensure enough contrast * between the system bars (such as status bar and navigation bar) and the app content. * *

* This layout is meant to be used in * edge-to-edge scenarios. The * {@link Protection}s are set using the {@link #setProtections(List)} method or directly in the * view constructor. * *

If this view will be attached to a hierarchy owned by a {@link android.view.Window Window}, it * is strongly recommended to call {@link androidx.core.view.WindowCompat#enableEdgeToEdge(Window)} * to make sure the view can reach the edges of the window and the framework color views are gone.

methods.name: public void setProtections(@NonNull List<Protection> protections)
methods.comment:
* Replaces existing {@link Protection}s with the given ones. Calling this with an empty list
     * will remove all the protections.
     *
     * @param protections a list of protections associated with a local area.
